jsonld_raw.name: MEANINGFUL MEMORIES EDP 100 ML
jsonld_raw.description:
MEANINGFUL MEMORIES EDP 100 ML. A collection inspired by memories that time transforms into part of our identity. Because there are moments that never stop accompanying us, and as the years go by, they end up defining who we are.

The velvety peach accord illuminates the richness of jasmine sambac absolute, while the heart of patchouli provides depth and an enduring elegance. A contemporary floral chypre where light and intensity coexist in perfect balance.

Floral chypre | Luminous, elegant and timeless
